name: LiveCRM
tagline: Deduplicate, normalize, enrich and update Salesforce and HubSpot, with every write audited and reversible
description:
A hosted MCP server for Salesforce and HubSpot. Thirty-six tools only read, answering from LiveCRM's own mirror of your CRM: count and look up records, find duplicates, check readiness, read the audit trail. Thirty change records, each behind a named permission you grant: merge duplicates, standardize field values, enrich from your data provider, assign owners, flag job changes, create records, mass update, and run multi-step plans on a schedule. Every write is recorded with its before and after values and can be reversed.

Requires a LiveCRM account connected to Salesforce or HubSpot. Sign in with OAuth when you connect; new companies can start a free trial at https://livecrm.ai/trial.
